surfaces.name: Played session record
surfaces.review: Expand the played record; distinguish estimates, suspicions, plans and confirmed events. Keep GM prep and future reveals out.

surfaces.name: Homepage
surfaces.review: Update latest-session hero, first recent card, Latesa chapter count and any changed city headline.

surfaces.name: Chronicle contents
surfaces.review: Add the chapter in reading order, including interludes; keep played date separate from in-world date.

surfaces.name: Previous and next chapters
surfaces.review: Connect both directions and the contents link; latest chapter has no invented next chapter.

surfaces.name: Public character references
surfaces.review: Review every affected character and their scene references. Check names and uncertain identities.

surfaces.name: Player-edited public profiles
surfaces.review: Live profile data overrides static seeds. Preserve player-authored prose; request or apply only supported, scoped corrections.

surfaces.name: Public NPC, location and lore pages
surfaces.review: Review established changes to people, places and open threads. Do not turn unplayed plans into facts.

surfaces.name: Exchange and writing center
surfaces.review: Nova owns fiction and its writer/PC/date metadata. Review links and relevant metadata; the static reader mirrors it. Recaps do not require a duplicate fiction post.

surfaces.name: Table state
surfaces.review: Review if maps, tokens or encounter state changed. Nova owns private notebooks and sheets; the Table owns saved scenes, handouts, artwork, manual turns and counters. Preserve live play state and private unrevealed material. Session recap publication must never automatically reveal or replace a scene, handout, map or token. Review any scene preparations deliberately with the GM. The Table also owns manual exploration cover, measurement templates, a private GM media shelf and owner-only session bookmarks. Selected bookmark exports are private writing preparation; review them before making a recap or story. Never include hidden map geometry, GM shelf previews or another player’s bookmarks in published content.

surfaces.name: Notification intent
surfaces.review: New fiction publications notify active players who opted into publication emails, individually, with an authenticated Exchange link. Draft autosaves stay silent; explicit tagged-writer calls send targeted updates. Inspect the publication ledger or turn status if an expected message is missing; confirm actual inbox delivery.

surfaces.name: Search, graph and sitemap
surfaces.review: Rebuild; verify latest record is discoverable. Never hand-edit generated public output.

surfaces.name: Editorial handoff copies
surfaces.review: These are generated editorial exports, not the live source. Refresh only when a handoff is requested; record deliberate deferral.

surfaces.name: Human interface verification
surfaces.review: Click home → latest → previous → next → contents and affected character references. Check light/dark and narrow/wide layouts. Record actual results, not merely that controls exist.
